Specs:

Model: A121E

Input: 100-240V 0.6A 50/60Hz

One-Port Output:

USB-C1: 5V⎓3A / 9V⎓3A / 15V⎓2A / 20V⎓1.5A (30W Max)

USB-C2: 5V⎓3A / 9V⎓2.22A / 15V⎓1.33A / 20V⎓1A (20W Max)

USB-A1 / A2: 5V⎓3A / 9V⎓2A / 10V⎓2A / 12V⎓1.5A (20W Max)

Two-Port Output:

C1+C2/A1/A2: 30W + 20W

C2+A1/A2; 15W + 15W

A1+A2: Total 15W

Three-Port Output:

C1+C2/A1/A2: 30W +Total 17.5W

C2+A1+A2: Total 15W

Four ports: 45W Max

Port number: USB-C *2 USB-A *2

Dimension: 54 x 73.73 x 49.5 mm

Weight: 3.58 oz (101.52 g)

Compatibility:

iPhone 17 / 16 / 15 Series Samsung S25 / S24 / S23 Series Google Pixel 9 / 8 Series iPad 11 / 10 / 9 / Air / Pro Series AirPods 4 / 3 / 2 / Pro / Max Series Apple Watch Ultra / S / SE Series Samsung Galaxy Watch 7 / 6 / 5 Series And More Charging Protocols: PD 3.0, QC 3.0, Appel, PPS, BC 1.2, FCP, SCP, AFC

FAQS:

Q1: Why does charging pause briefly when connecting or removing a device?

A1: When switching between single-port and multi-port use, the charger redistributes power across all ports. This can cause a brief interruption in charging, which is normal.

 

Q2: Why is charging slow when using multiple ports?

A2: When two or more ports are in use (USB-C2, USB-A1, or USB-A2), the combined output for all ports other than USB-C1 is limited to 15W. For faster speeds, use only USB-C and USB-C2, which provide 30W + 20W output.

 

Q3: Is it normal for the charger to get hot while charging?

A3: Yes, this is normal. This charger uses AI-based temperature control technology to maintain safety and reliability in line with international standards.

 

Q4: Why doesn't the charging speed always reach 30W or 20W?

A4: Charging speed varies depending on battery level, temperature, and how the device is being used. Maximum output is usually reached when the battery is low and the screen is off. This is normal and can occur even with the original charger.

aiTexts: The AIRDROPTECH GaN III PD Universal Travel Adapter is a compact (9.2*5.4*5.3cm), lightweight (268g) wall charger with interchangeable UK/US/EU/AUS plugs for over 200 countries.
It features 100W PD fast charging via a single USB-C port that can power laptops fully in 1.5 hours and charge phones like iPhone 13 from 0 to 54% in 30 minutes.
Supports PD 3.0, QC4+, PPS protocols ensuring compatibility with a wide range of devices including iPhone, iPad, MacBook, Samsung Galaxy, and more.
Uses advanced GaN III technology for efficient, low-temperature fast charging with built-in safety fuses to prevent overload and protect users.
AUTO-ID technology intelligently detects connected devices to optimize and safeguard charging current.
Ideal for travelers needing a versatile, efficient, and safe multi-device charger compatible worldwide.

product.highlights:
• 【Ideal for Travel】Portable(9.2*5.4*5.3cm) and lightweight(268g) USB adapter with interchangeable UK/US/EU/AUS plugs and international voltage compatibility, easy to carry, allows you to charge multiple devices simultaneously anywhere when you want. It can work in over 200 countries and is compatible with almost all USB devices.
  • 【100W PD Fast Charging】 With smart charging technology, it delivers an optimized charge to USB devices according to your device's needs. The single USB-C1 port (100W Max) can fully charge your laptop in 1.5 hours, or an iPhone 13 from 0–54% in 30 minutes. It also can used as a perfect Samsung charger block to provide full speed to the latest Samsung phones.
  • 【Universal Compatibility】This 100W charger supports PD 3.0, QC4+ and PPS to provide flawless compatibility charging speeds for all USB powered devices like iPhone 14/14 Pro/14 Pro Max/14 Plus/iPhone 13/13 Pro/13 Pro Max, iPad Pro/iPad Air, MacBook Pro/Macbook Air, Samsung Galaxy S22 Ultra/S21 Ultra Series, bluetooth earphone, e-reader, portable speakers, smart watches, cameras and other device.
  • 【Cutting-edge GaN III Technology】GaN Pro tech makes our latest travel adapter smaller without a drop of power, and provides better low-temperature fast charging experience. Equipped with integrated double 10A fuse for overload protection and safety valve, it will protect people from injury if they directly touch live parts on the socket.
  • 【AUTO-ID Technology for Intelligent Charging】 The Airdroptech travel adapter is capable of intelligently identifying connected devices and detecting and delivering optimum charging current, ensuring fast and safe charging.

aiTexts: The UGREEN GaN 100W USB C Wall Charger features 4 ports: three USB-C and one USB-A, delivering up to 100W power for simultaneous charging of phones, tablets, and laptops.

Powered by advanced GaN technology, it charges devices up to 3 times faster than standard chargers, reaching 60% battery in 30 minutes for iPhone 13 and full charge in 1.5 hours for MacBook Pro 16\" (2021).

It supports multiple fast charging protocols including PD 3.0, QC 4.0+, PPS, and more, ensuring broad compatibility with devices like MacBook, iPhone, Samsung Galaxy, Dell XPS, Google Pixel, and Nintendo Switch.
The built-in Power-X and Over Temperature Protection systems intelligently adjust output to protect device batteries and prevent overheating.
Compact sized at 2.72 x 2.72 x 1.3 inches and weighing 235g, it fits easily in work or travel setups, although it does not support Apple Watch charging.
Ideal for users needing efficient, multi-device fast charging with safety and versatility.

1: 67W GaN charger (intelligent low temperature fast charging, intelligent identification chip, charging protection, multi-device compatibility)

9:, Equipped with 1.0M 8-tail black PVC extension cable

3106550689.detail_html:
GaNSmart Technology takes the lead with its ultra-compact design, a remarkable 60% smaller than other original 30W wall chargers in the market. This innovative technology optimizes charging efficiency by ensuring minimal losses in the form of heat. It also supports Power Delivery 35W, PPS33W, and Quick Charge 3.0, all while providing essential safety features for worry-free usage.

Features
  • Ultra compact design
  • 60% smaller compare to other original 30W wall chargers in the market
  • GaNSmart Technology optimises charging efficiency by ensuring minimal losses in the form of heat
  • Support Power Delivery 35W, PPS33W and Quick Charge 3.0
  • Charge iPhone 14 Pro Max to 60% power in 30 mins
  • Supported Android devices to 80% power in 35 mins
  • Works flawlessly with all supported mobile devices
  • Auto-detect devices' power to deliver the fastest charge
  • Safety features for safe usage
Design
  • Input: 100-240Vac 50/60Hz 0.8A

FAQ

I cannot get both the fast charging to work?

You can only use one port at a time for the fast charging to work.

The charging speed slow when using both ports?

The total output will be adjusted to 20W when both ports are in use. Use only one port at a time to optimize its fast charging capabilities.
